Name: Phoenix Audio Limited
Description:
Here at Phoenix Audio, we believe it is everyone’s right to listen to music the way they want to - even if they don’t have perfect hearing. We know hearing aids can create a distorted and unpleasant sound, and that without any assistance, it may be hard to hear your favourite tracks as you remember them.

Developed for individuals looking for maximum listening enjoyment, Phoenix Audio is your own, personally calibrated audio system. By completing a simple hearing test online, your unique and personal audio profile, developed just for you, will be embedded into a portable device small enough to hold in one hand or slip into your bag. Easy to use with any set of headphones or earbuds, the Phoenix Audio system can be plugged into a wide range of analogue and digital sources so you can hear your favourite songs, enjoy movies or play video games with crystal clarity. 

The founder of Phoenix Audio, Mark Barratt-Boyes, knows his stuff. He has experienced hearing loss since birth. A lover of live music, Mark struggled to hear high-pitched sounds in particular, and found his hearing aids were a poor option. Mark believed he was not alone and there was a way to improve his listening experience. After many tests and trials, Mark has developed the Phoenix Audio system, which will allow almost anyone with hearing loss to gain maximum enjoyment of music, movies and video games.

Whether you have struggled to hear since birth, like Mark, or hearing loss is something you have developed with age or because of your lifestyle, the Phoenix Audio system will provide you with an individual and unique listening experience like never before.
